macros.name: background
macros.doc: \background fills the entire rectangular area of the flag with color; note: a flag needs neither a frame around it nor a background on principle.

macros.name: chevron
macros.doc: \chevron draws an isosceles triangle with a given height over the hoist.

macros.name: flaglength
macros.doc: \flagwidth and \flaglength specify the width and length of a flag.

macros.name: flagsdefault
macros.doc: \flagsdefault[opts] specifies default values for the Options opts for subsequent flags.

macros.name: flagvariant
macros.doc: By checking the macro \flagvariant, which has to expand to a single digit or character, TeX-code can be executed conditionally by use of \if...\else...\fi.

macros.name: flagwidth
macros.doc: \flagwidth is the unit for coordinates and lengths in the flag description.

macros.name: hbar
macros.doc: \hbar draws a horizontal bar of given width and color at a specified y-coordinate across the flag; \vbar does the same vertically.

macros.name: hstripesII
macros.doc: partitions the flag into two horizontal stripes with the colors c1 and c2 .

macros.name: hstripesIII
macros.doc: The macros \hstripesII, \hstripesIII, \hstripesIV, \vstripesII, \vstripesIII partition the flag into an according number of horizontal or vertical colored stripes.

macros.name: hstripesIV
macros.doc: The macros \hstripesII, \hstripesIII, \hstripesIV, \vstripesII, \vstripesIII partition the flag into an according number of horizontal or vertical colored stripes.

macros.name: unionjack
macros.doc: \unionjack draws the Union Jack (which is part of a couple of flags) between a lower left and an upper right point.

macros.name: vstripesII
macros.doc: partitions the flag into two vertical stripes with the colors c1 and c2 .

macros.name: vstripesIII
macros.doc: The macros \hstripesII, \hstripesIII, \hstripesIV, \vstripesII, \vstripesIII partition the flag into an according number of horizontal or vertical colored stripes.

macros.name: worldflag
macros.doc: \worldflag{xx} draws a flag, selected by the parameter xx, as a single TikZ-picture.
